Environmental exposure in the 15-minute city

Choose City profile or Local trade-off to explore the Figure 2 results. Dot size represents population. Select a city to open its MSA.

MSA rings follow CBG access times, not distance from the city centre. Preservation capacity uses the latest Figure 3 component-relative exposure: the population-weighted share of valid ≤15-minute layers reaching a Nature/Openness relative score of 1 against each outer ring. Cities outside the eligible sample show no preservation estimate.

Green chip outlines open verified 5 m models in 30 cities.

In a model, drag to pan, right-drag to rotate and tilt, and scroll to zoom. Click once to focus a building, then click a layer to inspect its mean. Choose Nature view or Openness. Layers are 5 m voxels, not surveyed floors. Tree canopy can be hidden while grass remains visible.

Building trade-off charts use paired finite model surface values with the latest national EEI z-score parameters. Metro rankings use repaired primary floors and publication exposure filters, with surface-weighted building means. CBG travel times are matched using original repaired boundaries and average nine categories, shown as a city-normalized access index. They are distinct from Figure 2 CBG-level EEI fits and Figure 3 ring losses. Missing results are never imputed.
